apps.localizedDescription:
Quake II (q2repro) for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Play Quake II on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — the full campaign, both mission packs, the 2023 re-release content, Action Quake II, and a stereoscopic 3D mode on Vision Pro that puts the game on a floating screen in your room with real depth. Or go all the way in with VR mode — step inside the level, aim with your hands, and play the whole campaign room-scale.

Built on q2repro (Paril's Q2PRO fork with Quake II re-release support), rendering natively on Metal via ANGLE. 100% vibe coded with lots of passion and attention to detail.

versions.localizedDescription:
visionOS VR (immersive 3D):

• Hand tracking, aim reticle and wheel cursor for the immersive mode.
• Per-eye lighting fixes: the "wall dark in one eye" bug (partial UBO update on the Metal backend) and stale dynamic-light bits.
• Layer-rate pacing and a GPU frame timer; Render Quality defaults to 1.5.
• VR settings sheet: HUD Size / Height / Spread (defaults 1.20 / -0.20 / 1.4), Menu Panel Size, FPS counter.
• Boot config and HUD scale overlay; ffmpeg zero-size packet fix for cinematics.

Build:

• Clean-clone bootstrap fixes: libcurl script on stock bash 3.2, q2proto submodule now initialised.
• Public builds compile out the dev remote console and fault-injection commands.

IPAs: q2repro-1.1.0-iOS.ipa, q2repro-1.1.0-visionOS.ipa (dev-signed; install via SideStore/AltStore or your own signing).
